name: Lexco Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Lexco specializes in supplying steel cable ends and wire rope cable ends for OEMs and industrial buyers who require precise, load-rated termination solutions. Each fitting is selected or manufactured based on application-specific requirements including load capacity, environment, connection type, and installation method.
about:
Lexco Cable Manufacturing operates from Norridge, Illinois, where it has been a family-owned business since its founding in 1974. The company began as a manufacturer of wire rope, cable, and bungee cord assemblies, serving both standard and custom applications.

Today, Lexco fabricates custom wire rope assemblies, cable assemblies, bungee cord assemblies, push-pull controls, and architectural cable railings. Its capabilities include custom cut-to-length services, crimping, swaging, and engineering support, all backed by ISO 9001-certified quality processes. The shop handles small- to high-volume production with flexible order quantities and low minimums.

The company serves military, OEM, MRO, distributor, and contractor markets, as well as specialized sectors such as aerospace and defense, fitness, and agriculture. Customers include general contractors and aftermarket sellers who require load-rated termination solutions tailored to specific load capacities, environments, and installation methods.

Lexco differentiates itself by combining custom assembly fabrication with practical production support, offering quick turnarounds, application-specific engineering, and a CAGE code (1VXG5) for government contracting. Its 50-year track record reflects ongoing investment in people, processes, and capabilities.
